noneDescription: Create one from a short prompt or your own material.
listDescription: Create, enroll, print and review your assessments.
firstDescription: Create your first assessment from a prompt or your teaching material.
deleteBody: This removes the assessment, its question blocks and enrollments. It cannot be undone.
createdToast: Assessment created. Review its learning objectives next.
createDescription: Give it a title and something to generate questions from. Each student will get their own questions.
lockedBody: It has been published or students have already started it, so its settings can no longer be changed. You can still enroll students and print papers.
